card.title: BLENHEIM Mk IV
card.flavorText: The Bristol Blenheim was a British light bomber/fighter designed and built by the Bristol Aeroplane Company. The aircraft was originally designed and produced as the fastest commercial aircraft in Europe, but its performance impressed the Air Ministry who ordered a modified design as the Type 142M for the Royal Air Force. The name was soon after changed to Blenheim Mk IV. The Blenheim became one of the first British aircraft with an all-metal stressed-skin construction, retractable landing gear, flaps, a powered gun turret and variable-pitch propellers. It was used by the RAF until 1944 and by then a total of 4,422 aircraft had been built.
